intro.fallback: Yamato sends a message from the Fire Temple back to Konoha, where Shizune reports its contents to Tsunade.

She ponders over the latest string of events - the grave robberies of three of the Twelve Guardian Ninja, the Akatsuki's plans, Orochimaru supposedly returning to hiding following his encounter against Team Yamato and...
Wanting to deal with the internal affairs first, Tsunade has Shizune dispatch Anbu members not affiliated with Root to observe Danzō at all times.

outro.fallback: At home, Danzō muses over Sai's request to stay on Team Kakashi, but before he can give it anymore thought, he senses the presence of the Anbu.
Wondering what Tsunade is up to, he tells himself not to worry as he holds all the cards in his favour.
